an6.27:3.2: ‘My heart is overcome and mired in ill will, and I don’t truly understand the escape from ill will that has arisen.
an6.27:3.3: Venerable, please teach me how to give up ill will.’
an6.27:3.4: Then that esteemed mendicant teaches them how to give up ill will.
